sections.Profile:
"400" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Genco Manufacturing Co. in July 1952. Designed by Harvey Heiss, this upright game features a vertical playfield, distinguishing it from traditional horizontal pinball machines.

- Manufacturer: Genco Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1952
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Original Theme, Weird Pinball Machines
